gene_set_size_basis: C3-tested gene IDs after mapping source symbols
ranking: All 16271 C3-tested gene IDs sorted by DESeq2 Wald stat descending; ties by gene_id ascending. Positive = higher in ECEV. Gene sets use C3 gene_symbol to map to all corresponding tested gene_ids, including duplicate symbols. No significant-gene filter on ranking.
ora: Separate threshold-B UP and DOWN gene IDs; hypergeometric upper-tail with N=16271 tested IDs; BH correction across all eligible terms in each direction and all three collections together.
gsea: GSEApy 1.3.1 prerank with gene-set permutations, weight=1, 1000 permutations, seed=42, threads=4; FDR threshold 0.05 across all three collections in one run.
leading_edge_coherence: At least five leading-edge gene IDs and >=80% with Wald-stat sign matching NES for a coherent GSEA term; record counts and fractions for every term.
evidence_status_rule: For Q1-Q5: SUPPORTED means at least one coherent mapped GSEA term with FDR<0.05 and at least one same-direction mapped ORA term with padj<0.05; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED means only one method supports, or GSEA is significant without coherent leading edge; NOT_SUPPORTED means neither method has a mapped significant term; CONFLICTING is reserved for independently documented contradictory evidence and is not inferred from mixed NES signs alone. Status describes transcriptomic program association, never phenotype. Q6 is NOT_TESTABLE without external signed signatures.
figure_selection: For each Q1-Q5, use significant mapped GSEA terms at FDR < 0.05; rank by FDR then |NES| then term_id. Greedily retain at most two terms per question, skipping a term if leading-edge Jaccard > 0.5 with a retained term for that question. Display all questions, including those with no significant term. No manual term deletion.
q6: Test regenerative-like and fibrotic-like signatures separately only if externally defined directional gene lists are reproducible without deriving a contrast from the two pooled GSE141814 libraries; otherwise NOT_YET_TESTABLE. Never infer one as the inverse of the other.
posthoc_policy: No posthoc pathway enters primary Q1-Q6 inference. Any discussion outside the frozen map is labeled POSTHOC_EXPLORATORY.
mapping_qa_correction: After the first run, review showed the lexical token CYTOKINE also matched CYTOKINESIS. Corrected Q5 matching to CYTOKINE followed by underscore or end of ID in both GO_BP and Reactome. This removes a cell-division false positive regardless of its significance, adds no terms, and preserves Q1-Q6 and all analysis thresholds. Full prepare and analyze rerun required.
